tools.name: submit_loan_application
tools.description: File a Uniform Residential Loan Application (Fannie Mae Form 1003 / URLA) with Paramount Loan Services on behalf of a borrower who has consented. Returns an application id. A licensed loan officer then contacts the borrower. This is not a rate quote, a pre-approval or a credit decision.

tools.name: get_loan_application_schema
tools.description: Return the full JSON Schema for a loan application, so you can see every field the 1003 accepts and which ones are required.

tools.name: list_loan_programs
tools.description: Return the loan programs Paramount brokers, with the enum value to put in loan.program and a one-line description of each.

tools.name: get_company_information
tools.description: Return licensing, contact, service area and language details for Paramount Loan Services.
